references: IMS Global — Question & Test Interoperability (QTI) v2.1
Universal Design for Learning (UDL) Guidelines v2.2
SCORM 2004 — Sharable Content Object Reference Model

layer_1_schema._description: Structural completeness — all required fields must exist with correct types

layer_2_completeness._description: Minimum content volume — industry standard for adaptive tutoring systems
layer_2_completeness._rationale: Question pool should be 3x expected per-session questions (8 per session → 24 minimum). Multiple difficulty levels ensure adaptive routing. Screenplay beats drive the immersive classroom experience.

layer_3_math_accuracy._description: Mathematical correctness — zero tolerance for wrong answers in an AI tutor
layer_3_math_accuracy._approach: Programmatic eval for simple arithmetic; pattern matching for multi-step; AI verification for complex
layer_3_math_accuracy.worked_example_check: answer must match eval(question) where question is parseable

layer_4_ai_quality._description: Pedagogical quality — AI-powered review using Claude to evaluate teaching effectiveness

teaching_clarity.description: Are teacherLines clear, age-appropriate (grade 5-8), jargon-free, and engaging?

difficulty_progression.description: Do questions scaffold logically from easy → medium → hard? No jarring jumps?

example_quality.description: Do workedExamples demonstrate the concept clearly with proper step-by-step method?

engagement.description: Is the content motivating, culturally relevant (Indian student context), and fun?

bloom_coverage.description: Do questions cover at least Remember + Understand + Apply levels of Bloom's taxonomy?

publish_gate._description: Rules for marking a chapter as ready to publish

statuses.validated: All layers passed, ready for AI review
statuses.approved: All layers passed including AI quality ≥ 7.0
